text: Date: March of 1965 - this is when the new arrivals started showing up with the AR-15. This was the first one I saw. We had stoners which are the prototype of the AR-15. Just a few special forces camps had them. They didn't have the site or the handle on it but they shot 223
researchNotes: Dates VN-0029 to about March 1965 by the rifle. At VN-0019 he calls the AR-15 there 'one of the first ones in Vietnam'. The 'stoners ... prototype of the AR-15' remark is recorded as said; the Stoner 63 was a separate, later design by the same designer.
